description: The host process's item in macOS's menu bar (baude_headless.py serve): a few words of what it is doing, the sessions at a turn or asking, and Quit.
opens: click the item in the menu bar

parts.name: Title
parts.shows: "Baude · N asking" or "Baude · N working" (asking first), else "Baude"; "Baude · restarting" or "Baude · stopping" while it is.

parts.name: Session lines
parts.shows: Up to twelve running sessions, asking first, then working, then the most recently active: each the chat's name (a Bot's name, never its chat's title; the title for any other chat; "(untitled)" if none), cut at 48 characters, then "asking", "working" or "waiting for you".
